SELECT 'kind_out' AS field, kind_out AS value, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM main.wicket_taken
GROUP BY kind_out
UNION ALL
SELECT 'role', role, COUNT(*)
FROM main.player_match
GROUP BY role
UNION ALL
SELECT 'players', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM main.player
UNION ALL
SELECT 'players_without_matches', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM main.player AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.player_match AS pm WHERE pm.player_id = p.player_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deliveries', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM main.ball_by_ball
UNION ALL
SELECT 'scoring_rows', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deliveries_without_scoring_row', NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
WHERE s.match_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'null_runs', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored WHERE runs_scored IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'missing_bowler_or_striker', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM main.ball_by_ball
WHERE bowler IS NULL OR striker IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'wickets_without_delivery', NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM main.wicket_taken AS w
LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
WHERE b.match_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'players_with_tied_top_role', NULL, COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT player_id
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS frequency_rank
        FROM main.player_match
        GROUP BY player_id, role
    )
    WHERE frequency_rank = 1
    GROUP BY player_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)

arguments.sql:
WITH role_rank AS (
    SELECT
        pm.player_id,
        pm.role,
        SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id) AS total_matches_played,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pm.player_id
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pm.role
        ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match AS pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.striker,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored,
        CASE
            WHEN w.kind_out IN (
                'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS wicket_credited
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s
        USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w
        USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT
        striker AS player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY striker, match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
        MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
        SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT
        bowler AS player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(wicket_credited) AS wickets_taken,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(wickets_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_wickets_taken,
        6.0 * SUM(runs_conceded) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id)
            / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS economy_rate,
        wickets_taken || '-' || runs_conceded AS best_bowling_performance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_id
            ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_conceded, match_id
        ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
)
SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    r.role AS most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(b.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(r.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
    1.0 * COALESCE(b.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
    b.highest_score,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
    COALESCE(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
    100.0 * b.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
    COALESCE(c.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
    c.economy_rate,
    c.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN role_rank AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS c ON c.player_id = p.player_id AND c.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT -1
